title: 68 - Recording
summary: [[character:jacques]] orders the drones back to full recording after [[technology:guppi-interface|GUPPI]] reports in [[technology:vr|VR]] that the new storage is online. Ahead of the [[species:others|Others]], he is documenting nature and Pav society and collecting genetic samples in separate stasis chambers. [[character:bill]] has persuaded him to avoid approaching the Pav, though Jacques reports a couple of sightings and ensuing rumors. To prepare for taking twenty thousand Pav, he identifies [[location:mheijrkva]] and Aizzilkva, each a little under ten thousand residents, with possible military bases nearby to make up the difference. Wary of becoming attached as [[character:bob-replicant|Bob-1]] did, Jacques has tiny [[technology:roamers|roamers]] bug a randomly chosen home there, keeping a record of a culture he expects to be gone within a decade. Observing the Los household, he singles out its matriarch, [[character:da-hazjiar-los]], for special handling if the plan goes ahead.

introducing.name: Mheijrkva
introducing.description: A rural Pav town on [[location:delta-pavonis-4]] with a stable population of just under ten thousand. [[character:jacques]] describes it as predominantly residential and oriented around families.
introducing.state: Jacques has selected the town for the planned evacuation and placed one randomly selected household under covert audiovisual surveillance.

introducing.name: Da Hazjiar Los
introducing.description: A Pav town councillor and the matriarch of the Los household, which has six adults and nine children. [[character:jacques]] regards her as intelligent and especially level-headed by Pav standards.
introducing.current_state: Jacques has flagged her for special handling if the planned evacuation goes ahead.

updates.current_state: He covertly records Pav life and the planet's environment, collects genetic samples in dedicated stasis chambers, and has identified two towns for a planned evacuation of twenty thousand Pav. He is monitoring the Los household.

updates.state: Jacques's covert survey records its life, landscapes, Pav societies and languages ahead of the [[species:others|Others]]. A couple of sightings of his equipment have fed conspiracy rumors among the Pav.
updates.description: The fourth planet of [[location:delta-pavonis]] and homeworld of the [[species:pav|Pav]], an industrial civilization of many states whose lights mark the night side and whose smoke is starting to warm the planet. Its towns include the rural settlement of [[location:mheijrkva]].

A metal-rich star system near [[location:gamma-pavonis]], about as far from it as [[location:gliese-877]]. An easily mined asteroid belt lies inside its first gas giant; [[location:delta-pavonis-4|its fourth planet]] is home to the [[species:pav|Pav]]. [[character:bill]] flagged it as a likely [[species:others|Others]] target before [[character:jacques]] came. Its Pav towns include [[location:mheijrkva]].
